scenes.text: This tutorial covers Image UMAP. Explore phenotype neighborhoods by embedding measured objects and displaying their image crops as glyphs.
Open Image UMAP from the Results and quality control section. Choose a measurements database, image crops, feature set, and grouping metadata.
In the main configuration area, configure filtering, scaling, neighbors, minimum distance, clustering, sampling, and image display channels.

Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. compare several reproducible embeddings and verify that clusters are not driven by plate or imaging artifacts.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR saves coordinates, cluster labels, image maps, and publication-ready embedding figures.
